cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you sign off 'delivery delay' for the melted cake? I'd rather the newsletter didn't make our committee look hopeless. Keep it brief, like I taught you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It arrived on time. We left it by the radiator.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good editing. You used to let that sort of detail pass. 'Storage problem', then. Can you approve it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if we mention the refund.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're getting quite thorough. 'Storage problem; full refund arranged.' Will you put your name under that?

reason: Cut the extra have-I-passed status question; specific pupil praise and revised account already show the concession needed to obtain endorsement.
